description: This file defines an Android activity showcasing a grid of cards with dynamically generated background images, using the Android Wearable support library components for a wearable device interface.

classes.name: GridExampleActivity
classes.description: Main activity for displaying a grid of fragments with custom background graphics.

classes.name: MainAdapter
classes.description: Adapter managing the grid layout, fragments, and background images.

classes.name: MainFragment
classes.description: A simple CardFragment displaying the row and column information.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and configures the grid pager with the adapter.

methods.name: getRowCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of rows in the grid.

methods.name: getColumnCount
methods.description: Returns the number of columns for a given row.

methods.name: getFragment
methods.description: Creates and returns a new fragment instance for the specified grid position.

methods.name: getBackgroundForPage
methods.description: Generates or retrieves the background drawable for a specific page, drawing a text label.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of MainFragment with row and column data passed via arguments.
